file.content:
---
name: repo MCP uses URIs not paths
description: When calling repo MCP tools, all identifying arguments must use MCP resource URIs, not file paths
type: feedback
---

Always use MCP resource URIs (not file paths) for identifying arguments in repo MCP tools like `ticket_reopen`, `ticket_close`, `ticket_open`, etc.

**Why:** MCP tools are resource-oriented; passing raw paths instead of URIs causes incorrect behavior or failures.

**How to apply:** Whenever calling repo MCP tools that reference tickets, goals, drafts, or other resources, use the URI format returned by MCP (e.g., from `search` results or `ticket_open` response) — never construct a raw path string.

Fixed. The issue was that both `coda/examples/coda-example/.coda/` and `coda/examples/semio-blnbo-roomprogram/.coda/` resolved to the same NX project name (`.coda`).

Added a `"name"` field to each [project.json](coda/examples/coda-example/.coda/project.json):
- `coda-example` → [coda/examples/coda-example/.coda/project.json](coda/examples/coda-example/.coda/project.json)
- `semio-blnbo-roomprogram` → [coda/examples/semio-blnbo-roomprogram/.coda/project.json](coda/examples/semio-blnbo-roomprogram/.coda/project.json)

NX now resolves both projects without conflict — you can retry `npx nx dev @coda/desktop`.
